# PinperLauncher

![Sample](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1HXXryTc/images/0fda6e78a671a054fa4d40b3a2d0623bfa2a3071.png)

An entertainment oriented NeoForge EarlyWindow implementation.

During certain holidays, Pinper will display specific startup text and background images.

## Usage
Open `config/fml.toml` and set  
`earlyWindowProvider = "pinperearlywindow"`

### Custom Background Image
Requirements: 800×450 resolution, PNG format.  
Name the file `pinper.png` and place it in the `config` directory.

### Custom Font
Requirements: TrueType font.  
Name the file `pinper.ttf` and place it in the `config` directory.

### Compatibility
Pinper is not compatible with any mods that modify the loading progress bar or the EarlyWindow system.

### Support
Pinper is an entertainment-oriented mod and does not accept any compatibility or bug reports.
